jobs.occupation: Top Pastry Chef – Specialised in Wagashi
jobs.description:
Location: Antwerp, Belgium 

 
Languages: English & Spanish
 

About the role
 We are looking for an exceptional pastry talent — someone who blends the refinement of 
Japanese wagashi with the expressive flavours of 
South America. As our Top Pastry Chef, you’ll create desserts that merge tradition, craftsmanship, and innovation into a unique culinary identity.
 

Key responsibilities
 
 

•  

Develop and perfect desserts inspired by Japanese wagashi techniques.
  

•  

Integrate South American flavours and textures into innovative pastry concepts.
  

•  

Collaborate closely with chefs and product development teams to bring ideas to life.
  

•  

Ensure top-level quality, presentation, and consistency across all creations.
  

•  

Mentor and inspire junior pastry chefs.
   

Your profile
 
 

•  

2+ years experience in high end pastry
  

•  

At least 
6 months of training or work experience in Japan, ideally in wagashi or traditional Japanese pastry.
  

•  

Proven experience working in or with South American culinary traditions.
  

•  

Strong aesthetic sense and technical mastery; storytelling through flavour.
  

•  

Fluent in 
English and Spanish; Japanese language skills are a plus.
  

•  

Creative, detail-oriented, and passionate about merging cultures through pastry.
   

What we offer
 
 

•  

A unique opportunity to shape your signature within an international high-end concept.
  

•  

Artistic freedom and room for culinary innovation.
  

•  

Competitive salary and growth potential within a creative, professional environment.

YOUR JOB IN A NUTSHELL

Ready to help shape a more sustainable future with BNP Paribas Fortis?
 We’re looking for a Scrum Master who fosters trust, encourages open dialogue, and helps teams play to their strengths.
 If guiding delivery, aligning efforts, and empowering people is what drives you, let’s build something meaningful together.

 

AND IN DETAIL

Play a key role in building responsible, high-impact digital banking services. We are hiring Scrum Masters across multiple domains: Channels, Invest, Payments, Cyber Defence, AI, and more.
 What you’ll do:

• Join a multidisciplinary team of motivated experts, collaborating closely with your Product Owner to deliver high-quality applications in a fast-moving IT landscape.
• Act as a Servant Leader: support your squad by removing obstacles, managing dependencies, and helping them stay focused on what matters.
• Own the delivery: take full responsibility for turning ideas into deployed solutions,  coordinating across teams (Scrum of Scrums) and ensuring releases go smoothly.
• Coach your team: nurture a culture of feedback, learning, and continuous improvement within and beyond your squad.
• Build impactful solutions using modern technologies like APIs, Kafka, React, and AI, contributing to secure and seamless client interactions.
 

You’ll be part of BNP Paribas Fortis’ mission to accelerate sustainable finance through smart digital innovation. You’ll work in an environment that values empowerment, ownership, and trust. You’ll grow alongside people who believe in collaboration and shared success.

If you’re passionate about people, tech and purpose, this could be your next step.

YOUR TALENTS AND COMPETENCES

What you bring to the team?

• A curious and proactive mindset, with the ability to stay focused and anticipate what’s next.
• The ability to create a psychologically safe environment where open feedback and learning are part of daily practice.
• A natural drive for collaboration, sharing knowledge and helping the team grow together.
• Strong leadership and coaching skills — capable of inspiring, aligning, and guiding the team through challenges.
• A critical thinker who isn’t afraid to question assumptions and promote continuous improvement.
• Confidence in taking full ownership of delivery, coordinating efforts across squads and ensuring smooth alignment.
• Solid grounding in Agile methodologies such as Scrum, Kanban or XP, with practical experience.
• A good understanding of software delivery from end to end — including infrastructure, cloud environments, networking, and system operations.
• Familiarity with modern engineering practices like CI/CD, DevOps culture, test-driven development (TDD/BDD), and infrastructure as code (IaC).
• An academic background in Computer Science, IT or a related field (Bachelor’s or Master’s degree).
• Several years of hands-on experience in a similar Agile delivery environment.
• Proficiency in Dutch or French, along with a good working knowledge of English.

Are you looking for a new challenging role where you can have a positive impact on digital transformation journey's ?

Join Capgemini as a SAP Solution Architect, and establish a long term relationship with our major customer, helping them optimizing their SAP transformation journeys.

 

CONTEXT

• As an End to End Solution Architect within Capgemini, your role is to help our clients in crafting, modelling and delivering a working end to end solution within one or more business domains.
• As a solution architect, you are involved in all aspects of an SAP project. During the design phase, you take the lead in creating a vision and a high-level solution, as a playing field for the different functional teams. During the build phase, you closely align with the technical architects to deliver a working solution, while monitoring the functional teams so that everyone adheres to the overall vision and solution. During the prep of the Go Live and the Go Live itself, you take the lead in guiding the client towards a successful transition and a smooth start-up.
• You work in tandem with the project manager, in a joint responsibility for the success of the project in scope, timeline and budget. You provide tactical input towards the steering committee, the delivery manager and the account manager. As part of the core team for a project or customer, you are the face of Capgemini and try to defend our interests, while delivering according to client expectations.
• Your role is to drive excellence for our clients through innovative (standard) SAP solutions crafting and strategic leadership and vision, optimizing performance and processes for sustainable business success.
 

YOUR ROLE

• Solution Design: collaborate with cross-functional teams to craft, design and implement a new and effective SAP-based solution that aligns with business objectives and best practices, based on SAP’s on-premise and cloud portfolio of solutions.
• Project Leadership: work closely together with the project manager and lead the functional teams, overseeing the entire project lifecycle from a solution and delivery perspective, ensuring high quality delivery according to client expectations, but also timely and within budget.
• System Configuration: keep in touch with the system and the latest SAP solutions and toolsets, in order to support our functional teams to configure and customize SAP to meet specific organizational requirements, ensuring seamless integration with existing systems and processes in or out of SAP; while sticking as close as possible to the standard of SAP
• Team Management: manage and mentor consultants of various levels of expertise; providing guidance, training, and support to enhance their skills and contribute to project success
• Internal management and contributions: As a senior colleague within Capgemini, you actively follow the latest developments, roadmaps, toolsets and strategic visions of SAP, and you actively share your findings within the Architecture Community and beyond.

YOUR PROFILE

• 10+ years of SAP project experience in a line of business, a sector or a solution suite, with proven knowledge in a SAP solution design and solution architect role
• Extensive knowledge of the latest SAP technology portfolio, on-premise, in the cloud (BTP, CALM,...) and ecosystem for your domain of expertise, and how to apply them in a clean core approach
• Knowledge of common non-SAP technologies that are used your domain of expertise, such as : GIS, Copperleaf, IoT, Field Service Management, transport management solutions, ServiceNow, integration platforms, automated warehouse management solutions, …
• A collaborative spirit & customer-oriented attitude, being able to lead both internally and externally
• Result-driven & focused on delivering quality, within the boundaries of a project and a contract
• Fluency in Dutch or French is mandatory and professional working proficiency in English

Choosing Capgemini means choosing a company where you will be empowered to shape your career in the way you’d like, where you’ll be supported and inspired by a collaborative community of colleagues around the world, and where you’ll be able to reimagine what’s possible. Join us and help the world’s leading organizations unlock the value of technology and build a more sustainable, more inclusive world.

Join Capgemini as a SAP Backend Consultant and play a pivotal role in shaping the digital backbone of a client’s organization, driving innovation and digital transformation.

jobs.occupation: CE Truck Driver with On-Board Forklift (Moffett)
jobs.description:
Job description 

Welcome to the wonderful world of truck drivers! You will hit the road with an impressive tractor-trailer combination. Waking up early is essential, as you will be leaving between 5 and 7 in the morning. Don't worry, you are allowed to work around 12 hours a day, which is more than enough time to make the asphalt disappear under your fantastic vehicle. Of course, you are a true adventurer, so crossing a border occasionally doesn't faze you. Fortunately, most of it is national work, so you won't need an international driving license.

You will make between 4 to 6 stops a day, which means you will spend a lot of time on the road. Naturally, as a superhero driver with a CE license, you will be responsible for loading, transporting, and delivering various goods. Do you have experience with a fork truck (kooiaap)? Then you have an advantage. But don't panic if that's not the case, because you can still receive training for it internally. And if you're a true night owl, you can also take night trips for this position. The choice is yours! Just let us know.

 Requirements 

    
• Driver's license: CE + code 95.
    
• Knowledge of Dutch, French, or English.

We are looking for an experienced pipe fitter for an ongoing project in Geel.

As a company, we are a European player specialising in complex construction projects such as data centres.

Together with your team, you will be responsible for preparing, installing and aligning stainless steel pipes used for sterile/clean processes.

In practical terms, this involves the following tasks:

• Interpreting (3D) plans and diagrams (process flows, pipes, valves, instruments, etc.)

• Installing (hygienic) stainless steel and carbon steel pipes

jobs.description:

Digital Marketing Manager

Your Future at 3CON

The 3CON Group is an internationally successful hidden champion in plant engineering and special-purpose machinery. For many years, we have been developing high-end solutions for the automotive industry, the life sciences sector, and other demanding industries.

We are 3CON — bold pioneers, dependable problem-solvers, and a family-run global player. With over 800 employees worldwide across Austria, Germany, the USA, Mexico, and China, we shape industrial manufacturing at the highest level.

To strengthen our team, we are looking for a committed and creative individual to join us as a:
Digital Marketing Manager (m/f/d) — B2B / Life Sciences

Your Responsibilities:

● Planning, optimizing, and analyzing performance campaigns (LinkedIn Ads, Google Ads), along with ongoing SEO optimization of our new WordPress website.

● Structured qualification and handover of marketing leads to our sales teams.

● Creating white papers, technical articles, case studies, and web content tailored to decision-makers in the pharma and biopharma sectors.

● End-to-end organization of major international trade fairs (e.g. CPHI, Interphex), including compliance with all booth-construction and logistics requirements.

● Strategic development and editorial planning of our social media activities.

● Monitoring campaign and event budgets.

● Experienced in international B2B marketing, combined with a solid technical understanding of the pharma, biopharma, life sciences sector.

● Sound knowledge of LinkedIn Campaign Manager, Google Ads, SEO, and analytics tools.

● Fluent, business-level English (written and spoken) is essential — it is our primary working language.

● Very good German (written and spoken) is also required for day-to-day collaboration.

● A structured way of working and strong execution skills when meeting complex deadlines.

● Hands-on experience with WordPress and CRM systems is an advantage.

● Basic graphic design skills for independently creating social media posts and smaller marketing materials are desirable.

● Experience organizing international trade fair appearances.

What We Offer:

● Challenging tasks in an international environment with flexible working-time models.

● State-of-the-art workplaces designed to the latest ergonomic standards.

● Individual development paths through a wide range of internal and external training opportunities.

● The opportunity for assignments abroad at our plants (Mexico, China, USA), including special bonuses.

● An in-house 3CON Health Center with a company doctor, sports offerings, and subsidized therapeutic massages (50% covered).

● An excellent company restaurant serving freshly prepared, regional dishes at preferential prices.

● A genuine team spirit fostered through regular sports, team-building, and social events.

jobs.occupation: Finance Head (f/m/d) - Discrete Projects Industrial Logistics (Betriebswirt/in (Hochschule))
jobs.description:
We're seeking a Finance Head (f/m/d) for Industrial Logistics within Digital Industries Automation Discrete Projects (DI AUT DP). In this role, you'll lead global financial management for our Industrial Logistics (IL) project business across Europe and Americas – as part of the global Finance function under our new ONE Tech Company structure.
This is your chance to shape financial operations throughout the complete project lifecycle – from bid calculations to project closure – while ensuring IFRS 15 compliance, financial performance analysis, and effective risk management. You’ll drive profitable growth, sustainable margin improvement, stable cash generation, and financial resilience through disciplined risk control across multiple countries. You'll work in a transformation environment with a clear focus on business growth, where your financial expertise directly contributes to our goals of speed, scale, and efficiency.
At Siemens, our Total Rewards approach is designed to inspire innovation, reward impact, and support your well-being at every stage of your career. From competitive pay and benefits to recognition and development opportunities, we help you thrive both personally and professionally.
You’ll make an impact by - Financial Leadership & Strategy: You lead global financial management and controlling for the Industrial Logistics project business, reporting to the Head of Finance of DI AUT DP. You drive growth and productivity initiatives to strengthen its competitive position. You govern the adoption of finance and controlling policies and guidelines based on the overall FIN strategy while ensuring compliance with all relevant financial regulations (external and internal).- Budget Planning, Forecasting & Financial Reporting: You coordinate budget planning and forecasting for the entire IL project business, ensuring IFRS-compliant accounting and timely preparation of financial closings as well as accurate books and records (monthly, quarterly, annual).- Performance Monitoring: You monitor and comment on financial performance (current development and outlook) incl. KPI analyses and performance reporting. You analyze, approve, review and forecast project revenues and costs, and ensure accurate profitability throughout the project lifecycle, as well as initiate early warnings to stakeholders when needed.- Project Finance & Risk Management: You identify and manage financial risks associated with the execution of projects, including currency, credit, and operational risks, ensuring proper risk assessment and provisioning in calculations and financial statements.- Operational Improvement & Innovation: You identify operational improvement potentials in controlling and financial processes, propose solutions and remedial measures, and drive productivity improvements through automation and innovation initiatives.- Collaboration & Transformation: You work with IL management, operational leadership, and central finance functions while supporting organizational transformation by challenging the current processes and collaborating across all stakeholder groups (e.g., FIN, P&O, EHS, GBS, SCM).- Team Leadership & Development: Finally, you manage and develop Finance and Controlling teams supporting the global IL project business. Traveling to its locations and project sites is necessary.

Your success is grounded in- Education: University degree or equivalent experience in Finance, Business Administration, Accounting, or related field - Experience and Skills:- Minimum 8-10 years in Finance, Controlling, and FP&A, preferably in international project business- Minimum 5 years leadership experience leading finance teams across multiple locations and building collaborative relationships - Proven expertise in IFRS 15 revenue recognition for long-term project contracts and commercial contract negotiations with OEM procurement organizations. Familiarity with project business models in automotive or comparable industrial environments is a strong differentiator.- Demonstrated hands-on experience in commercial contract negotiations with OEM procurement organizations, covering pricing structures, risk allocation, liability caps, and penalty/malus clauses. Ability to engage with customer purchasing teams and to represent Finance as a value-creating business partner in complex commercial discussions.- Strong knowledge of financial planning, budgeting, and controlling- Deep understanding of risk management, internal controls, compliance and audit requirements- Proficiency with ERP systems (SAP preferred) and advanced MS Office skills- Experience with organizational transformation and implementation of new business operations is beneficial

- Ways of Working:- Strategic vision meets financial excellence – combining big-picture thinking with process optimization and attention to detail- Collaborative influencer who builds trust across cultures and translates complex financial insights into clear, actionable messages- Proactive, adaptable, and able to thrive in evolving business environments - High integrity with commitment to Siemens Business Conduct Guidelines and compliance requirements
- Languages: Business proficiency in English; German language skills are a plus. Additional languages are highly welcome and beneficial for international collaboration.

You are much more than your qualifications, and we believe in the potential of every single candidate. We look forward to getting to know you!

jobs.description:
Who is Siemens Energy?

At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100,000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.

Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy ... 1 Head of Order Management (m/f/d) Medium Power Transformers A Snapshot of Your Day

As Head of Order Management (m/f/d) Medium Power Transformers, you lead the organization responsible for managing the factory's customer order portfolio within an Engineering-to-Order business. You ensure the successful execution of projects from order intake to delivery, meeting targets for schedule, cost, quality, and customer satisfaction. In addition, you drive the transformation of the order management organization by strengthening project management excellence, advancing digitalization, and continuously improving processes and standards. In close collaboration with customers, engineering, manufacturing, procurement, sales, and senior management, you contribute significantly to operational performance, profitability, and sustainable business growth.

How You'll Make an Impact

 * Lead, develop, and inspire the Order Management organization, fostering accountability, collaboration, and a high-performance culture.
 * Ensure the successful execution of the project portfolio in close collaboration with Commercial Project Management (CPM), managing project performance, risks, opportunities, profitability, quality, and customer satisfaction.
 * Drive organizational and process transformation, including the implementation of best practices, digitalization initiatives, and standardized project management methodologies.
 * Establish and continuously improve project management standards, governance, milestones, and quality gates in alignment with global business requirements.

What You Bring

 * Master's degree in Industrial Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Business Administration, Supply Chain Management, or a comparable field.
 * Extensive leadership experience in project management, order management, or a comparable function within a complex manufacturing or Engineering-to-Order environment.
 * Proven track record in leading organizational change, transforming processes, and driving continuous improvement and digitalization initiatives.
 * Strong expertise in project, risk, contract, and stakeholder management, combined with excellent communication, moderation, and decision-making skills.
 * Fluent German and English language skills and experience working successfully in an international and intercultural business environment.

At Siemens Energy we offer competitive compensation and additional benefits based on your performance, experience and qualification. Due to the Austrian legal regulations, we are obliged to state the minimum salary for this position. Please note that there is a clear willingness for a higher compensation considering your individual expectations, expertise and skills. The minimum salary for this position in the collective agreement for the electrical and electronics industry is in the amount of € 84.028,28 gross/year for a full-time position, plus an All-In agreement including a variable compensation component.
